text:
Alex M: ptal — I've addressed the review comments around shard ownership and the rollback policy. pushed a small rebase and dropped an extra debug log. CI is green except one flaky e2e that looks unrelated. trying to land this before tomorrow's canary window (09:00 PST). PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/1234 CI: https://ci.company/1234 :pray:
Priya K: looking now, thanks. quick q — did you keep the old metric tag for legacy dashboards? we still query it in prod alerts.
Alex M: good call, i left an alias in the exporter config. snippet: `metrics.tags.add("shard_owner", owner)` — added a migration note in the PR description.
Samir: fyi this touches the shard router so canary needs a short heat-up to validate steady-state. i can take the 09:00 slot if everyone is ok.
Jordan: one suggestion — can we add a short perf smoke after canary start to verify p95 token latency? a 10-min load test should be enough.
Alex M: yeah i'll wire a quick `wrk` job and post results to the PR. added a smoke playbook step in the runbook.
Priya K: reviewed the code itself — LGTM apart from one tiny formatting nit in router_test.go. i'll approve once that's fixed.
Alex M: fixed and pushed `fmt` change. thanks.
CI Bot: build #2298 passed — unit, lint, integration. e2e #44 failed (timeout) — retriggered.
Samir: thanks — when CI is fully green i'll queue the canary. needs 1 more approver from infra. @Jordan can you give a quick second look for the perf check?
Jordan: will do a 10-min pass in ~30m. if all good, +1.
DeployBot: scheduled canary window reserved: 2026-03-19 09:00-09:30 PST. preflight checks required.
Alex M: awesome — CI is green now. merging after Jordan's perf +1 or will hold for 10m if he doesn't respond. thanks all for the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
Priya K: thanks Alex, great cleanup.
Jordan: +1 perf looks stable on the smoke run, no regression visible in p95. go ahead.
Alex M: merged and queued for canary. will monitor the dashboard and post results in this thread.
DeployBot: canary deploy started. monitor: https://infra.company/canaries/5678
Alex M: canary passed baseline checks — promoting to prod after one more 30m observation. posting CPU/RPS snapshots: `cpu: 72% -> 69%`, `rps: 1200 -> 1185`. no errors.
Samir: nice — thanks for handling the ops side.
Priya K: nice work :tada:
